author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
With so many projects going at once, does Adam Savage ever walk into a room and forget why? Which tool does Adam never use but won't give up? Which YouTubers did Adam love hanging out with at his recent open house, and would he ever return to DEF CON? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from Tested members Lee Miles, PDXASM, TheElderCryptid and kyleaidenfox, whom we thank for their support! Do you have a tool you never use but still keep?
